title: Long-form content package
description: One ready-to-render LONG video (16:9, 8-11 minutes): a themed list of 8-12 verified facts, one chapter each. Files live in content/longform/queue/<id>.json. The job renders one per day (when the daily 8 PM slot is free), uploads it and moves the record to content/published/ with kind=longform.

id.description: Date created + slug, e.g. 2026-10-17-space-facts-that-sound-fake. Also the file name.

theme.description: One of the topics in channel.yml (space, animals, science, history...) - picks fallback footage and colours.

title.description: Searchable list title with the number in it, e.g. '10 Space Facts That Sound Fake (But Are Real)'. No < or >.

intro.description: 24-60 words the voice says first (10-20 s): state the theme, promise the best one is last, no 'welcome to the channel'. This is chapter 'Intro'.

segments.description: One fact per segment, in order. Put the 2nd-strongest fact first and the strongest LAST (tell people so in the intro).

heading.description: Chapter name shown on screen and in the description, e.g. 'It rains glass on HD 189733b'.

text.description: 120-160 words the voice says (40-55 s). First sentence = the fact itself, plain words. Then the proof (number, comparison, who found it), then why, then one line that lands it.

keywords.description: 2-3 concrete footage searches for this segment, shown one after another, e.g. ['blue planet space', 'glass shards storm', 'telescope observatory night'].

sources.description: 1-2 URLs that verify THIS fact (listed in the description).

outro.description: 15-60 words: the payoff line, a question for the comments, and 'a new fact every evening' (no 'like and subscribe' begging).

description.description: 3-5 lines: what the video covers, the strongest fact as a teaser, a question. Chapters, hashtags, footer and sources are appended automatically.

thumbnail_text.description: 3-5 huge words for the thumbnail, e.g. 'IT RAINS GLASS'.

thumbnail_label.description: Small pill on the thumbnail, default '10 FACTS'.

intro_keywords.description: Optional footage search for the intro (default: first segment's first keyword).

outro_keywords.description: Optional footage search for the outro.
